text:
alex: main just went red after merge of #4832 — gpu-integration job gpu-int/kv-cache failed on `kvcache-integration-test`

deploy-bot: Pipeline failed: https://ci.redwood.internal/pipelines/7821/jobs/kv-cache (status: failed) :rotating_light:

maria: ugh. any flakes in the logs or a clear stack?

alex: looks like `CUDA out of memory` at step `kv_lookup` in the trace. small heap growth though, could be flaky nvml oom. snippet:
```
RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory. Tried to allocate 512 MiB (GPU 0; 16.00 GiB total, 14.2 GiB already allocated)
  File "tests/integration/test_kvcache.py", line 87, in test_kv_eviction
    result = model.run(input)
```

sam: can someone rerun the job first? sometimes a transient node. jen — you're listed as owner of that test module, can you take a look? @jen

jen: on it. kicking a rerun for job 7821 now.

deploy-bot: Rerun started (job 7821, attempt 2)

jen: rerun finished — still failed. exact same OOM in `kv_lookup`.

maria: hmm. maybe a change in batch sizing or a hidden regression from #4832 fuzzing the allocation pattern. alex do you remember if that MR touched runtime batching?

alex: it did a small change to continuous-batcher thresholds, but only in internal heuristics. CCing @sam in case of runtime kernel changes.

sam: that MR shouldn't change device memory math but could shift request packing. quick idea: try running the failing test locally with smaller batch or set env `REDWOOD_BATCHER_DISABLE=true` to bypass batching. jen can you try a local reproduce with `REDWOOD_BATCHER_DISABLE`?

jen: running locally now, single test with `REDWOOD_BATCHER_DISABLE=1 pytest tests/integration/test_kvcache.py::test_kv_eviction -q`

jen: local run PASSED with batching disabled. with batching enabled it fails reproducibly. so it's batching pressure + memory cliff.

alex: OK that's good signal. two short-term options: (1) revert the threshold tweak in #4832, or (2) add a temporary guard in CI to set `REDWOOD_BATCHER_DISABLE=1` for that flaky test while we root cause. I lean revert to get main green quickly.

sam: can we bisect the small change? it's just one commit in the MR. alex — can you open a revert PR?

alex: creating revert PR now — https://git.redwood/reverts/r-4832 — marking as urgent.

maria: also created a ticket to track follow-up: INF-2147 (investigate batcher memory cliff + add regression test).

jen: thanks. I'll add a short note to the test owner list so we don't hit this again in CI (and add a guard test for eviction mem use).

alex: re-run CI after revert? sam — can you kick a new pipeline once revert is merged.

sam: yep will watch. in the meantime, tagging this thread with :eyes: and moving to post-merge triage board.

jen: quick FYI — added logs + heap snapshots to INF-2147, linking them in the ticket.

alex: thanks all — main will be unblocked after revert lands and CI runs green.

maria: :thumbsup:
